Sun & Moon series · SLG

Shining Legends

Released October 6, 2017 · 81 cards

Expanded

Shining Legends is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on October 6, 2017. Its main set has 73 cards, plus 8 secret rares numbered beyond the set (81 in total). It includes 66 Pokémon, 13 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

27 illustrators worked on Shining Legends. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (12), Mitsuhiro Arita (5), kawayoo (4), nagimiso (4), Ryo Ueda (4), Toyste Beach (4), Kagemaru Himeno (3), Ken Sugimori (3).
